attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster (node1, node2, node3) using MariaDB 10.1.48 with galera-3 (wsrep-enabled). Verified multi-master writes replicate across all members, verified availability with one member offline plus automatic resync (IST) on rejoin, and completed the mandatory one-at-a-time node-restart protocol on all three nodes with changed boot-id proof and full post-restart cluster/data recovery.
